item.title: Theft/Intruder detection on Android w/ Tasker
item.description: If you have a smartphone, surely you covet it’s presence and usage. It probably doesn’t leave your sight very often, and losing it would be a huge inconvenience to you, perhaps almost disastrous. Thankfully, there’s a slew of services out there that help you locate your lost or stolen device, remote wipe it, etc. in case this happens. I’m going to highlight one more tool available to you in your smartphone arsenal that can help you keep tabs on your device. Also, this tool can be used for quite a bit more than security. Since this is a linux blog, of course I’m going to be talking about the android platform 🙂 .
